API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APIPrivileged Credential ManagementDeletes the privileged credential for the specified ID.
Deletes the privileged credential for the specified ID.
DELETE
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/credential/:id

Deletes the privileged credential for the specified ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

id
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the privileged credential.

QUERY PARAMETERS
microtenantId
int64

The unique identifier of the microtenant of ZPA tenant. For Default microtenant 0 should be passed and for Customer data microtenant should be null.

Responses
​
204
400
401
403
404
